_about: What git said when a push failed, and how it is sorted: the kind, origin's own first line where the board shows it, and the cleaned text behind the (?). Pins core/scripts/lib/git-error.sh and dashboard/src/format/git-error.ts to the same answers.

cases.name: SSH key the host does not accept, with git's carriage return (a real push from the serving host)
cases.said:
git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.

Please make sure you have the correct access rights
and the repository exists.
cases.detail:
git@github.com: Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
Please make sure you have the correct access rights
and the repository exists.

cases.name: HTTPS credentials refused
cases.said:
remote: Invalid username or password.
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/x/y.git/'
cases.detail:
remote: Invalid username or password.
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/x/y.git/'

cases.name: A 403 over HTTPS
cases.said:
remote: Permission to x/y.git denied to someone.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/x/y.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
cases.detail:
remote: Permission to x/y.git denied to someone.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/x/y.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403

cases.name: GitHub's Internal Server Error on a remote rejected line (a real push from the serving host)
cases.said:
To github.com:ragnarwestad/aide-specs.git
 ! [remote rejected]   aide/new-e1110633 -> aide/new-e1110633 (Internal Server Error)
error: failed to push some refs to 'github.com:ragnarwestad/aide-specs.git'
cases.detail:
To github.com:ragnarwestad/aide-specs.git
! [remote rejected]   aide/new-e1110633 -> aide/new-e1110633 (Internal Server Error)
error: failed to push some refs to 'github.com:ragnarwestad/aide-specs.git'

cases.name: A 502 over HTTPS
cases.said:
error: RPC failed; HTTP 502 curl 22 The requested URL returned error: 502
fatal: the remote end hung up unexpectedly
cases.detail:
error: RPC failed; HTTP 502 curl 22 The requested URL returned error: 502
fatal: the remote end hung up unexpectedly

cases.name: No network: the host name does not resolve
cases.said:
ssh: Could not resolve hostname github.com: nodename nor servname provided, or not known
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.

Please make sure you have the correct access rights
and the repository exists.
cases.detail:
ssh: Could not resolve hostname github.com: nodename nor servname provided, or not known
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
Please make sure you have the correct access rights
and the repository exists.

cases.name: No network: the connection times out
cases.said:
ssh: connect to host github.com port 22: Operation timed out
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
cases.detail:
ssh: connect to host github.com port 22: Operation timed out
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.

cases.name: A protected branch: origin's own first line, without remote: and error:
cases.said:
remote: error: GH006: Protected branch update failed for refs/heads/main.
remote: error: Changes must be made through a pull request.
To github.com:x/y.git
 ! [remote rejected] main -> main (protected branch hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'github.com:x/y.git'
cases.message: GH006: Protected branch update failed for refs/heads/main
cases.detail:
remote: error: GH006: Protected branch update failed for refs/heads/main.
remote: error: Changes must be made through a pull request.

! [remote rejected] main -> main (protected branch hook declined)
error: failed to push some refs to 'github.com:x/y.git'

cases.name: A non-fast-forward: the rejected line, not the To line or the hints
cases.said:
To github.com:x/y.git
 ! [rejected]        aide/49-an-organiser-can-crop-the-cover-image -> aide/49-an-organiser-can-crop-the-cover-image (non-fast-forward)
error: failed to push some refs to 'github.com:x/y.git'
hint: Updates were rejected because the tip of your current branch is behind
hint: its remote counterpart.
cases.detail:
To github.com:x/y.git
! [rejected]        aide/49-an-organiser-can-crop-the-cover-image -> aide/49-an-organiser-can-crop-the-cover-image (non-fast-forward)

cases.name: Anything else: its own first line, cleaned
cases.said:
[31mfatal: 'origin' does not appear to be a git repository[0m
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
cases.message: 'origin' does not appear to be a git repository
cases.detail:
fatal: 'origin' does not appear to be a git repository
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
